decks.name: Town of Millbrook
decks.description: Build a town from scratch: peasants work, buildings train them into an army, and the Town Chief mobilizes the population in emergencies.

decks.name: Blackrock Raiders
decks.description: No workers, no patience. Earn gold through violence: kill for bounties, burn buildings for plunder, and steal what the enemy saved.

decks.name: AX-01 War Machine
decks.description: You brought an army; I brought one machine. No units, no gold — just energy, modules, and one increasingly dangerous robot backed by its Landing Pad.

decks.name: Arcane Conclave
decks.description: A network of casters pooling mana into the Nexus. Counterspells, fading summons, and fireballs for everyone.

decks.name: The Restless Court
decks.description: Death is inventory. The Graveyard banks corpses; the Necromancer turns every casualty into power.

decks.name: The Brood
decks.description: Eggs hatch, larvae evolve, and everything is food. Wants its own units to die almost as much as yours.

decks.name: Shadow Guild
decks.description: Spies burrow under enemy buildings, secrets wait face-down, and gold changes pockets unseen.

decks.name: Alchemist Guild
decks.description: Weak bodies, strong chemistry. Freeze, dissolve, weaken and transmute the mighty into mutton.
